theorems.name: Submission.isoperimetric_lattice_face_isolating_form
theorems.statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (ρ δ : ℝ) (F₀ : LatticeFaceIndex n N), 0 < ρ → 0 < δ → δ < 1 / 4 → ∃ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl N)) n, ω ∈ massAdmissibleOn (univ : Set (Eucl N)) n univ ∧ (∀ F : LatticeFaceIndex n N, F ≠ F₀ → latticeFaceAction ρ F (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl N) n) = 0) ∧ (ρ * (1 - 2 * δ)) ^ n ≤ latticeFaceAction ρ F₀ (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl N) n)
